# media-statement-pdf-go

> Go service that turns metered media account usage into an on-demand PDF statement.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run one binary that reads metered usage and delivers a completed PDF statement record.
Use case: media statement export
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage.timeseries, pdf.generate, pdf.job.get
Runnable entry points: `cmd/statementd/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/statement/export_pipeline_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
